Let G be a permutation group on the finite set Ω. A partition ρ of Ω is said
to be G-regular if there exists a subset S of Ω such that S g is a transversal of ρ for all
g ∈ G. The group G is said to be synchronizing if |Ω| > 2 and there are no non-trivial
proper G-regular partitions on Ω.
    a) Are the following affine-type primitive groups synchronizing:
2p .PSL(2, 2p + 1) where both p and 2p + 1 are prime, p ≡ 3 (mod 4) and p > 23?
2101 .He?
    b) For which finite simple groups S are the groups S × S acting on S by (g, h) :
x 7→ g −1 xh non-synchronizing?                                          P. M. Neumann
